answer: Price verification by the market. Every identity’s work is checked by verifiers who stake their own standing, and the fee floats with demand — so the more identities a farm pushes through the inlet, the more the market charges to verify each one. A vine that grows a thousand tendrils pays a thousand times, and the price rises as it grows, because honest verifiers are scarce and their attention is the reef the economy rests on. Attacks fund their own opposition: every unit spent on scale raises the wage of whoever catches them. Sybil resistance becomes self-financing.
